ann.l: Several well-formed teeth with white enamel crowns project from the specimen, proof that tissue from more than one germ layer has differentiated inside this ovarian germ cell tumor.
A tuft of fine hairs grows from skin-like tissue at the left, because the lining of a dermoid contains skin with hair follicles and sebaceous glands.
The teeth are embedded in a thick, solid piece of the cyst wall, the Rokitansky nodule, where bone, teeth and most solid tissue of a dermoid concentrate.
